Definition
[Rays and Busemann functions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0479 1. appi:1.1\group Busemann geometry For a noncompact Riemannian manifold $(\M ^n,g)$, let $\Ray _{\M }$ be the set of unit-speed geodesic rays, and let $\Ray _{\M }(p)$ denote those starting at $p$. For $\gamma \in \Ray _{\M }$ define \[ b_\gamma (x)=\lim _{s\to \infty }(s-d(\gamma (s),x)),\qquad b_p=\sup _{\gamma \in \Ray _{\M }(p)}b_\gamma . \]
